gaps_closed.link_to_obligation1: δ is NOT the parallel-chord B(μ). B bounds chord-sum for d>1 parallel lines (ParallelBudgetGeometry). δ bounds excess long-leg length of a dominated corner with half-angle z. Queries named H<delta(z) use parallel budget B together with δ as the geometric upper target for the free chord H.
